text:
Iran's foreign minister held talks with his Saudi and Qatari counterparts on diplomatic progress toward regional stability, according to an Iranian statement cited by Reuters.

via OSINT613

Update: additional footage shows Russia's Ryazan oil refinery burning in a massive fire after the overnight Ukrainian drone strike.

via OSINT613

🚨 Leaked Russian defence docs show a 2022 to 2025 contract with Iran for APU L dual rail launchers for the Kh 39 LMUR missile (Izdeliye 305).

Iran has also taken delivery of Mi 28NE attack helicopters that can fire the LMUR.

via OSINTWarfare

🚨 Tehran University professor Hamzeh Safavi, son of a former IRGC chief:

"Iran can make Israel uninhabitable with Kheibar Shekan missiles, dirty bombs, and chemical weapons.

Real deterrence doesn't necessarily require a nuclear weapon."

via OSINT613

Kremlin pushback: Putin envoy Kirill Dmitriev dismisses reports that Russian diesel tankers bound for the United States have changed course.

His one word verdict: "Fake."

via OSINT613

Sweden will reinstate checks at its internal borders for six months.

The government cites a serious threat to public order and internal security, driven mainly by Russia's full scale invasion of Ukraine.

via OSINT613

🚨 Trump: "I have every intention to keep him."

President Trump says he intends to keep Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, despite the complaints.

via OSINT613

Update: every aircraft hit by today's bomb threats across Europe landed safely.

At least 16 planes were affected today, pushing the 72 hour total to at least 25.

via OSINT613

Putin will not get an invitation to next year's G20 summit in Manchester.

British Prime Minister Burnham confirmed the decision, The Economist reported.

via OSINT613

A Chinese J 20 air superiority fighter in "Beast Mode," loaded with 14 missiles.

External hardpoints: 8 PL 15 air to air missiles. Main internal bay: 4 PL 15s. Side bays: 2 PL 10s.

via OSINTWarfare

Yemen's Presidential Leadership Council issued three calls to residents living under militia control.

Hold firm to the republican system. Protect children from recruitment. Refuse to let homes be used for military purposes.

via OSINT613

🚨 In the heart of Tehran, the Islamic regime is displaying footage of President Trump being hanged.

via OSINT613

🚨 Jordanian security officials call a stabbing in Amman a terrorist attack.

One security officer was killed and a second wounded. Authorities say the attacker was arrested.

via OSINT613

IRGC Ground Forces chief Karami, touring the Gulf islands, says Iran's forces are ready to deliver a decisive response to any hostile action.

"The proud people of Iran and the Resistance Front will not back down even an inch in the face of the enemy."

via OSINT613

🚨 Lebanon has issued arrest warrants for two Hezbollah operatives, Ali al Kurdi and Haitham Amhaz.

The warrants are tied to the explosives truck the Lebanese army seized at Dahr al Baydar in the Bekaa Valley.

via OSINT613

Update: Romanian reports say a Wizz Air flight from Milan also received a bomb warning and landed safely in Bucharest.

It adds another diversion to today's wave of European flight bomb hoaxes.

via OSINT613

🚨 A missile test launch was recorded in Parand, in Iran's Tehran Province.

via OSINT613

Update: Czech police say no explosives were found on the 4 Prague bound planes hit with bomb threats.

It follows a wave of bomb hoaxes targeting European flights this morning, with diversions to Bulgaria, Prague and Rome.

via OSINT613

🚨 Iran's Army Navy says another tanker hit a sea mine east of the Strait of Hormuz this morning, caught fire and stopped.

Like others mined in recent days, the ship had switched off its tracking systems. The report is unverified.

via OSINT613

🚨 Czech Police: 4 aircraft bound for Prague received bomb threats and are diverting to Prague Airport.

Security forces are preparing for the landings. Police assess the credibility of the threats as low.

via OSINT613
